intro: OpenID Federation 1.1 for this trust realm. Trust between entities that were never configured with each other, through a chain of signed statements ending at a Trust Anchor. This realm is a {role}.
entityHeading: This realm as a federation entity
everyRealmSubordinate: Every realm a subordinate of the default
noKey: No key yet; the first statement this realm signs makes one.
keysNote: The keys this realm signs its federation statements with, kept apart from its protocol signing keys (3.1.1). A next key is published before it signs; a retired one stays published through oidfed.keyOverlapDays and is listed at the Historical Keys endpoint for good (8.7). New keys are {alg} (oidfed.signingAlg).
noSubordinates: This realm vouches for nobody; it publishes no fetch or list endpoint.
subordinatesNote: The entities this realm issues Subordinate Statements about (8.1): their keys, and the metadata, policy and constraints the statement carries. Registering an entity VOUCHES for it — give its JWK Set, or read it from its own Entity Configuration. A SUSPENDED subordinate is issued no statement and listed nowhere until it is reinstated, so no chain passes through it; REVOKING one removes it. Every one of those acts, and every change to what its statement carries, is kept in its history for good and served by the subordinate events endpoint.
fetchJwks: read its keys from its Entity Configuration
phJwks: its JWK Set, if not read
phEventDescription: what the history records about it
notThisId: — not the identifier this page was reached by, so the endpoint does not answer from it
noCrawl: No crawl is kept; the collection endpoint answers with what this service collects without fetching — its own realms, and subordinates already resolved.
collectionNote: Every entity beneath this realm, for the collection endpoint: each resolved to this realm before it is kept, and each Intermediate outside this service asked for its list only once it has — through the outbound policy, bounded by oidfed.collectionMaxEntities and oidfed.collectionMaxFetches.
crawlEvery: The scheduled crawl runs every {s} s.
anchorsNote: The entities a Trust Chain may END at (10.2), each with the keys configured for it here — the one key material in a federation that is trusted out of band.
marksNote: A Trust Mark is this realm's signed statement that an entity meets a type's criteria (7). The types it issues, the marks it has issued (their status is answered at the Trust Mark Status endpoint), the marks issued TO it that its Entity Configuration carries, and — as a Trust Anchor — who may issue a type.
phDelegation: a trust-mark-delegation+jwt, when the type is owned by another entity
phTrustMark: a trust-mark+jwt issued to this realm
policyHeading: As a Trust Anchor: who may issue a type
resolveNote: Walks the entity's authority_hints up to one of this realm's Trust Anchors, fetching what it must through the outbound policy and bounded by oidfed.maxAuthorityHints, oidfed.maxChainDepth and oidfed.maxFetchesPerResolution; the result is what the resolve endpoint then answers with ({n} held now).
